resources.string: No API key yet — tap “Key” to add one.
This model is not available to your key. Pick another one from the model list.
Check the API key, then the model name.
The key was rejected. Tap “Key” and use Save & verify to see why.
Rate limited — wait a moment and try again.
Google’s side is failing right now. Retrying usually works.
Empty answer — the output budget was likely spent on internal reasoning. Retry, or rephrase the question.
Google rejected this key (HTTP %1$d).%2$s\n\nUsually the key was revoked, belongs to a project with the Generative Language API switched off, or was only partly copied.
Could not check the key: HTTP %1$d%2$s
Could not reach Google to check the key: %1$s
That is a web address, not a key. Open it, then copy the key it shows.
That looks like an OpenAI key. This assistant talks to Google Gemini; get a key at aistudio.google.com.
The key looks cut short at %1$d characters. Check that all of it was copied.
